name: Sticky shrinking header
definition: Site header that stays pinned while the page scrolls, compacting and gaining a divider once the visitor leaves the top.
bestUse: Long pages where navigation and the main call to action should stay one click away.

demo.how: Scroll the page inside the window: the header stays at the top and, once you leave the first screen, shrinks to a compact bar with a shadow so it takes less room while keeping the call to action visible. The page can be scrolled with the mouse or with the arrow keys after focusing it.
